grid.radial_rule: quadratic edges; midpoints in squared radius

storage: fields.npz uses float32 for plotting; all evaluations and CSV summaries use float64

definitions.plastic_strain: sum_k [gamma_m grad(g_m) + gamma_j grad(g_j)]; engineering xy shear
definitions.footprint: area where accumulated equivalent plastic strain >= 10 microstrain; display contour only
definitions.units: displacements in mm; strains dimensionless; coordinates divided by tunnel radius

radial_kinematics.strain_definition: Full strain of the excavation displacement: d(u_r)/d(r), from spatial AD.
radial_kinematics.annulus_integral: Full angular profiles use u_r(R_Gamma)-u_r(a); A/B use 32 quadratic radial panels with 32 Gauss points each.
radial_kinematics.cumulative_integral: From the wall to radius r: u_r(r)-u_r(a), in mm.
radial_kinematics.units: Displacement and integrated contributions: mm. Strain: dimensionless. Coordinates: r/a.
